zh: 一个元素同时存在严格更小和严格更大的元素，等价于它严格大于全局最小值、并且严格小于全局最大值。相同的中间值出现在多个位置时，每个位置都要计数。
先扫描一遍求出最小值 lo 和最大值 hi，再扫描一遍统计满足 lo<值<hi 的位置个数。
读入数组，求出 lo=最小值、hi=最大值；遍历每个位置，若其值严格大于 lo 且严格小于 hi 则计数加 1；输出计数，所有值都相等或只有两种值时结果可能为 0。
en: An element has both a strictly smaller and a strictly greater element exactly when it is strictly above the global minimum and strictly below the global maximum. If the same middle value appears at several positions, each position counts.
Scan once to find the minimum lo and the maximum hi, then scan again and count the positions whose value satisfies lo < value < hi.

Read the array and compute lo = minimum and hi = maximum. For every position, add 1 to the count if its value is strictly greater than lo and strictly less than hi. Print the count; it can be 0, for example when all values are equal.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let lo=min(nums) and hi=max(nums). A position in the array satisfies the requirement if and only if its value lies strictly between lo and hi; the count is taken position by position, so equal middle values are not deduplicated.

## Proof of correctness

If lo < x < hi, the array has an element equal to lo and an element equal to hi, which are strictly smaller and strictly greater than x respectively, so x satisfies the requirement. Conversely, if x satisfies the requirement, there are a smaller element and a greater element, so x must be strictly greater than the global minimum and strictly less than the global maximum. Hence the qualifying positions are exactly those with lo < nums[i] < hi, and the algorithm's position-by-position count is correct.

## Complexity

Two linear scans: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
